title: coreJ split-storage rule documentation sidecar
description: Schema for a single rule's citation prose under rules-src/docs/<FAMILY>/<Core.Id>.yaml (plans/done/PLAN-rule-storage-split.md). Holds the bulky Cited_Guidance / Document / Item / Section text lifted out of the rules-legacy Authorities tree, keyed by the same (Standard, Version[, Substandard]) tuple as the check file's Standards[] entries so the assembler can re-join them. Never read by the execution engine. YAML on disk; validates as JSON Schema after parsing.

Core.description: The Core.Id of the check file this sidecar documents (rules-src/checks/<FAMILY>/<Core.Id>.yaml); the two are joined by it.

Citations.description: The citations of every reference of the check's Standards block, keyed by the reference's locator key (Organization|Name|Version|Substandard|Id|Version[#n]) and lifted out of the check file so the authored rule stays small; the generator joins them back into Authorities.

Cited_Guidance.description: The quoted text of the standard the rule implements, or null.

Document.description: The document the citation is taken from, e.g. "IG v3.4", or null.

Item.description: The item within the document (a table, a variable, a rule number), or null.

Section.description: The section number of the document, e.g. "4.4.4", or null.
